description: This file defines a REST controller named AccountController for a banking application. It handles HTTP requests related to bank accounts and transactions, such as retrieving account details, adding accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction history.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: A REST controller managing banking account operations such as retrieving account details, creating new accounts, transferring funds, and fetching transaction histories.

methods.name: getByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new account for an existing customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to transfer funds between accounts.

methods.name: getTransactionByAccountNumber
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all transactions for a given account.
